original_test_intent: Verify that each required PCIe switch board exposes the correct BMC FRU record and that its specification-defined identity fields are readable, internally coherent and represented consistently in BMC Web.
original_method: Resolve the switch-board population and corresponding FRU device/area, preserve existing evidence, collect the complete inventory through approved IPMI access, compare each required field with the board-specific source of truth and have an operator confirm the mapped Web representation.
manual_activity: The platform owner maps every applicable PCIe switch board to a stable FRU identifier and expected field set; an operator confirms the corresponding BMC-Web presentation and owns the final judgment.
required_inputs: SUT and PCIe switch board PN/revision/population/slot map
Per-board FRU device ID, area and display-name mapping
Expected manufacturer, product, part, serial, asset and version fields where applicable
Allowed blank/optional fields, formatting, encoding and comparison rules
BMC Web page/record/field mapping and refresh behavior
Read-only ipmitool transport and credential policy
PCIe/link and BMC health baseline, retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Capture the complete FRU inventory before selecting any PCIe Switch view
Do not identify a board solely by a grep label when multiple switch FRUs may exist
Do not accept six following lines as a complete record
Use read-only inventory commands only; prohibit FRU edit/write, firmware, reset and power actions
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL without separate approval and preserved export
Protect BMC credentials and retain redacted raw output
Stop on missing/duplicate/malformed record, inventory churn, authentication/transport or switch/link/BMC anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and switch-board population
Collect complete raw FRU list/print output through approved access
Resolve each required switch FRU by stable ID and board mapping
Compare all required fields with expected data and identify omissions/mismatches
Prepare the exact Web rows for operator parity confirmation
Capture before/after BMC, FRU, PCIe/link and log health without state changes
Do not write inventory or decide the verdict
engineer_actions: Provide the expected field matrix and normalization rules
Resolve duplicate or missing inventory identities
Review field/link exceptions and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A full read-only `fru print` is relevant, but piping it directly to `grep -iA6` discards the stable record boundary and fields beyond six lines. It cannot prove all required switch boards or Web parity and exposes the password in argv.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe approved IPMI access to retain the complete FRU inventory, select each owner-mapped PCIe-switch FRU by stable device/area identity, compare its full required field set, then correlate the exact BMC-Web record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PCIe SW BD, `ipmitool fru list`, readability/correctness/Web comparison and 10/10-minute estimates are preserved; no switch count, FRU ID or expected value is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SWITCH-BOARD FRU MAP AND FIELD ORACLE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate switch boards and FRU IDs, archive the complete raw inventory, decode the full mapped records, compare a board-specific field matrix and confirm the exact Web objects while monitoring PCIe/BMC health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic device identity and complete-record comparison without changing the source's passive FRU purpose.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable `PCIe Switch` snippet may be the wrong board or omit serial/part/version fields; link enumeration is useful health context but does not replace FRU correctness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only FRU access is low impact, but misidentification can associate the wrong service part or firmware history with a switch board and corrupt diagnostic evidence.

project_override_considerations: If one platform has no separate switch-board FRU or exposes multiple boards under vendor-specific names, the applicability decision and mapping must be explicit. Do not silently treat a motherboard or switch-ASIC inventory record as the required board FRU.
expected_evidence: PCIe switch board population, slot/location and FRU device/area map
Versioned expected field and normalization matrix
Complete redacted raw FRU list/print output with exit status
Per-board decoded fields and expected-versus-observed comparison
Timestamped BMC-Web records and field parity results
Before/after BMC/FRU, PCIe topology/link/errors and preserved log health
No-write/no-clear audit, exception handling and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently describe a PCIe-switch-board FRU read and Web comparison. Missing field values and mapping are readiness gaps, not conflicting source assertions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The FRU operation is explicit and non-destructive. Board/FRU/Web mapping and expected fields can be supplied by the project, after which complete evidence collection is deterministic.

review_improvement: Replaces a fragile name snippet with a per-board stable-FRU comparison, covers multi-switch platforms and separates FRU identity proof from supplemental PCIe link health.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe switch systems often contain more than one switch or board, while FRU labels are not guaranteed unique. A six-line textual slice can appear valid even when it belongs to another device or omits the discriminating serial/part fields. Correct evidence must first bind physical board location to a FRU device/area, preserve the whole record and only then compare Web and specification fields. This remains conditional read-only automation, not a physical inspection case.
